solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Band with time to focus on beat

parts.note: to watch something is to keep one's attention fixed on it
to strap someone is to thrash them with a leather strap

explanation.surface: A musical group with a drummer told to concentrate on keeping the beat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Band' looks like a group of musicians and 'beat' like rhythm; here the band is a strip that holds a timepiece, and to beat is to thrash.
explanation.definitionFit: This strip of leather or metal fastens a timepiece to the wrist, so it is a band that carries the time.

clue.text: Unfortunately the late Flo-Jo?

indicators.note: something gone unfortunately has gone wrong, so the letters of the words that follow are put out of order

explanation.surface: A sad remembrance of the sprinter Florence Griffith-Joyner, who died young in 1998.
explanation.walkthrough: Flo-Jo was the nickname of Florence Griffith-Joyner, the US Olympic sprint champion; the question mark marks her as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Florence Griffith-Joyner was a record-breaking sprinter, an example of a sportsperson in track and field.

clue.text: Caterer emptied fish and lobster basket

indicators.note: a word emptied loses all its inside letters, leaving only the first and last of Caterer

parts.note: an eel is a long snake-like fish

explanation.surface: A caterer clears out the fish and a basket of lobster, perhaps after a seafood banquet.
explanation.definitionFit: This wicker basket is used by anglers and as a trap or carrier for lobsters and other shellfish.

clue.text: Society publication is revolting

definitions.note: a noun here: the act of rising against authority

parts.note: an edition is one published issue of a book or paper

explanation.surface: A club's magazine is condemned as disgusting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolting' reads as an adjective meaning disgusting, but it is the noun sense, the act of rebelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Incitement to rebel against the state is a form of rising up against rulers.

clue.text: Having hunch delivery task needs to be taken on

parts.note: a round is a regular delivery route, like a milk or paper round
to have shouldered a burden is to have taken it on

explanation.surface: Someone with a gut feeling says a delivery job must be accepted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hunch' looks like an intuition; here it is a stoop of the back. A paper round is the British delivery route a child does before school.
explanation.definitionFit: A person with a stooped back and forward-curving posture has a hunch to their shoulders.

clue.text: European language that might be French?

definitions.meaning: French ... is a shellac finish for wood, one kind of shine-giving coating

explanation.surface: A puzzle over which tongue of Europe might turn out to be French.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the language of Poland and a coating that gives a shine, of which French polish is a type.

clue.text: Bow demo leader cancelled

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, and it is cancelled, so it goes

parts.note: a demo is a protest march

explanation.surface: The head of a protest is called off, perhaps a bow of apology to follow.
explanation.definitionFit: A curved bow, as in a bridge or doorway, is an arched structure; the two words share that bent shape.

clue.text: Vague old American with scholar up at famous university

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the letters read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: an MA, a Master of Arts, is a scholar
a big U is a big-name university

explanation.surface: An unclear old American goes up to a well-known university with an academic.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unclear, open to more than one reading, is vague in meaning.

clue.text: Performance when Romeo comes into court

indicators.note: comes into says these letters go inside the court abbreviation

parts.note: once can mean when, as in 'once he arrives'
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A show staged at the moment Romeo walks into a courtroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical event before an audience is one kind of performance.

clue.text: Succeeded with ground- breaking device in Oxford?

parts.note: S is a standard abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees
a hoe is a garden tool for breaking up soil

explanation.surface: Praise for an innovative invention that triumphed at Oxford.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground-breaking' looks like innovative; taken literally, it is a tool that breaks up ground. Oxford is not the city but a lace-up leather style of footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: An Oxford is a classic lace-up leather item of footwear, so the question mark marks an example.

clue.text: Dilemma for two people born in Germany

parts.note: a double is a pair, or a person's exact lookalike
D is Germany's international vehicle code, from Deutschland

explanation.surface: A tricky choice facing a couple both born in Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: This phrase names a situation where every option is bad, a dilemma with no way out.

clue.text: Wine demonstrating excellence — look for one

indicators.note: for says one thing stands in for another: the look word replaces the one

parts.note: merit is worth or excellence
I is the Roman numeral one
lo is an old word meaning look

explanation.surface: A wine shows its quality, so go and look for one.
explanation.definitionFit: A red grape variety from Bordeaux and the wine made from it.

clue.text: Stylist perhaps does without representation

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the deer go round the sign

parts.note: does, plural of doe, are female deer
a sign is a symbol, a representation

explanation.surface: A hairdresser perhaps manages without being shown on screen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'does' reads as a verb but is the plural of doe; 'without' means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A fashion or interior creator is a stylist in a broad sense; 'perhaps' admits it is a loose example.

clue.text: Large beast and two insects circling husband

indicators.note: circling says the insects surround the husband letter

parts.note: a bee and a moth are two insects

explanation.surface: A big creature and a pair of bugs buzz round a married man.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical monster is a by-word for any huge creature.

clue.text: One running boozer beset by Brussels taxes?

indicators.note: beset by says the pub is surrounded by the other letters

parts.note: Brussels is the seat of the EU, the European Union
rates are local property taxes in Britain
a boozer is a pub, a public house, PH

explanation.surface: A pub landlord is hounded by EU tax demands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running' looks like managing a pub; it is flowing water. PH is the map abbreviation for public house.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is something that runs, and this one flows through Turkey, Syria and Iraq.

clue.text: Bavarian king ran from Walpole's castle

indicators.note: from here means taken away from: the run of letters goes

parts.note: Horace Walpole wrote The Castle of Otranto, the first Gothic novel

explanation.surface: A Bavarian monarch fled from a fortress belonging to Walpole.
explanation.definitionFit: Otto was King of Bavaria from 1886 to 1913, brother of Ludwig II.

clue.text: Being in minor gas explosion

indicators.note: an explosion blows the letters apart into a new order

explanation.surface: A person caught up in a small gas blast.
explanation.definitionFit: A living thing, plant or animal, is a being.

clue.text: Source of inflation turned back by politician

indicators.note: turned means the word is read the other way round

parts.note: to back is to hold up or support, giving up
MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician

explanation.surface: Rising prices are reversed thanks to a politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inflation' suggests the economy; it is literal blowing up, as of a tyre.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyre or balloon is blown up with air from this device, its source of inflation.

clue.text: Releases piratical captain held by leaderless barbarians

indicators.note: held by says the captain is held inside the barbarians
the barbarians lose their leader, their first letter

parts.note: the Huns were barbarian invaders
Captain Hook is the pirate in Peter Pan

explanation.surface: A pirate captain held captive by barbarians without a chief is set free.
explanation.definitionFit: To unfasten something from a catch frees it, so it releases it.

clue.text: Mounting disorder?

definitions.meaning: a revolt or rebellion, a public disorder

explanation.surface: A puzzled question whether things are getting more chaotic.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective-like participle for climbing and the noun for a rebellion against rulers.

clue.text: Party enforcing six-pack ban? That's impossible!

parts.note: a ban on six-packs of beer means no can is allowed
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A party that bans six-packs of beer is told it simply cannot work.
explanation.definitionFit: This pidgin phrase is a curt refusal meaning the thing cannot be done.

clue.text: Aggro where British done — five arrested

indicators.note: arrested means held: the done word holds the five

parts.note: over means finished, done
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: A report of a fight where a Briton was beaten up and five people were taken into custody.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for trouble or fighting; aggro, short for aggravation, means the same.

clue.text: Female cross going round wide forest

parts.note: she is the female pronoun

indicators.note: going round says the cross surrounds the wide letter

parts.note: a rood is a cross or crucifix
W is the cricket abbreviation for a wide

explanation.surface: An angry woman storms around a big forest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' reads as angry; it is a crucifix. The forest is Robin Hood's, in Nottinghamshire.
explanation.definitionFit: This woodland in Nottinghamshire is the forest of the Robin Hood legend.

clue.text: Expert grips weight immediately

indicators.note: grips says the expert holds the weight inside

parts.note: an ace is an expert
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A weightlifting expert takes hold of the barbell straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: This phrase means right now, without delay.

clue.text: Ultimate tribute about astronaut's fourth circuit

indicators.note: about says the tribute goes round the picked letter

parts.note: an obit, an obituary, is the final tribute paid to someone

indicators.note: fourth picks out the fourth letter of the word astronaut

explanation.surface: A final tribute marks an astronaut's fourth trip round the Earth.
explanation.definitionFit: A path round a planet is a circuit, a complete loop.

clue.text: Composer to drive men potty

indicators.note: potty means crazy, so the letters go mad and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A composer whose music drives men crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: Claudio Monteverdi was the Italian composer of early opera, including L'Orfeo.

clue.text: Maybe rib second-class individual

parts.note: B grade is second class
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: Perhaps someone teases a person of lower standing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rib' looks like a verb meaning tease; it is a part of the skeleton.
explanation.definitionFit: A rib is one example of a piece of the skeleton.

clue.text: Idiot embracing Kelvin pops question

indicators.note: embracing says the idiot holds the kelvin letter inside

parts.note: an ass is a fool
K is the symbol for kelvin, the unit of temperature

explanation.surface: A fool hugging someone called Kelvin proposes marriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pops question' suggests a proposal; here it simply means puts a question.
explanation.definitionFit: To pop a question is to put it suddenly, which is to enquire.

clue.text: Minder poet abused seeks atonement

indicators.note: abused means mistreated, so the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: A bodyguard who mistreated a poet now looks to make amends.
explanation.definitionFit: Salvation or making amends for wrongdoing is a synonym of atonement.
